jobs.title: Internship - Software Engineering - Spring 2027
jobs.description:
About Firefly Aerospace

Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.

Summary

Firefly has year-round Aerospace Software Engineering internship opportunities for our Hive location in Leander, Texas. Both current undergraduates and new graduates are encouraged to apply.

As a Firefly Aerospace Software Engineering Intern, You Will

Support Flight Software, Ground Software, or Guidance, Navigation, and Control engineers working on launch vehicle or spacecraft programs
Adhere to Aerospace Software Engineering processes, procedures, and best practices
Perform assigned work onsite and on time

Required

Enrollment or a recent graduate in a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree program with a focus on Aerospace Engineering, Computer Sciences, Software Engineering, or a related field at an accredited four-year university or college
Knowledge in a specific software engineering or aerospace engineering area such as orbital mechanics, trajectory analysis, control theory, filtering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, database technologies, networking, embedded software, or a related field
Experience with software development in C++, Python, or LabVIEW
Good verbal and written communication skills
The ability to prioritize and execute assigned tasks on time
Good collaboration skills to work closely with others in a fast-paced environment

DESIRED

Experience with source code Version Control tools
Participation in a related extracurricular university club or laboratory

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Firefly Aerospace, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Firefly is governed based on merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Delivery
jobs.description:
Back to jobs

New

Software Engineer, Agent Delivery

New York

About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

$135,000 - $180,000

Full-time / Onsite (5 days/week)

About The Role

We’re hiring a Software Engineer, Agent Delivery to deploy production AI agents inside some of the world’s largest supply chain companies.

You’ll work directly with customer operators, engineers, and executives to understand how critical workflows actually run. Then you’ll design integrations, debug production systems, and ship AI-powered workflows into environments that are often undocumented, fragmented, and business-critical.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer operations. You’ll own deployments from initial discovery through production launch, spending time with customers both remotely and onsite, solving complex operational problems and turning those solutions into reusable product capabilities.

Success in this role is measured by outcomes: can you get systems live, make them reliable, and solve problems in environments you don’t fully control? Every deployment teaches us something new about how supply chain companies operate. The patterns you uncover become product features, and what you solve for one customer often becomes a capability we ship across the platform.

The impact you will have

Lead high-impact customer deployments from problem definition through production, designing, prototyping, building, and deploying AI agents and workflows that change how work gets done and run reliably at scale.
Embed in customer workflows and build relationships from ICs and operators up to executives, turning messy business requirements into clear technical solutions that solve the underlying problem, not just the first request.
Make design decisions across agent behavior, application logic, data, evals, security, and reliability, and set the patterns for how Pallet agents are deployed in production.
Connect Pallet agents to the systems, APIs, and data customers already rely on, working directly with their engineering and ops teams to get around technical constraints.
Stay accountable after launch by debugging failures, evaluating and improving agent quality, and working with Engineering and Product to clear anything blocking a successful deployment.
Turn what you learn in the field into reusable agents, integrations, evals, and frameworks, and bring recurring needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering to shape the core platform.

Who You Are

1+ years of experience building and owning production systems in high-growth startups or similarly demanding environments.
Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and event-driven architectures.
Proven ability to debug complex systems in production.
Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where documentation is incomplete, and requirements evolve quickly.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working directly with customers is a strong plus

Our Tech Stack

Backend: Node + TypeScript on Encore.dev. Event-driven design with message passing and queues. Hosted on GCP
Database: PostgreSQL
LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google for foundation models; fine-tuned models on Vertex AI
Browser Automation: Playwright
Frontend: Next.js + React + TypeScript. Hosted on Vercel
Observability: Datadog for logging and metrics

Location:
New York, Flatiron, 5 days a week

The estimated salary range for this role is $135,000–$180,000, depending on experience and skill set. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and growth opportunities. Final compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors, including experience, qualifications, and location.

Our Benefits

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits
🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation
➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance
❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage
💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff
🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future
🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families
📚 Yearly learning and development stipend
🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area and New York employees
🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office
🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space for remote employees
📸 Free professional headshot
🍔 Daily catered lunches and dinners provided in office
💪 Complimentary On-Site Gym: Our SF office has a fully equipped gym
✈️ Onboarding trip to one of our offices if you work remotely
🥤 Monthly happy hours
🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip.

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Accommodations

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at recruiting@pallet.com
.

jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
The AI & Automation Engineer
is a hands-on technical role responsible for designing, building, deploying, and supporting AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, and automation solutions on Company-approved AI platforms. The position transforms prioritized use cases into secure, supportable production solutions, develops reusable patterns and knowledge layers, and serves as the primary technical builder for the Company's AI and automation programs under the direction of the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI.

This position will require regular (every week) in-person attendance at one of our Foley Equipment offices with a partial week work-from-home opportunity. At this time, fully-remote is not available. Kansas City or Park City preferred.

What You Will Do

Solution Design and Development

Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Foundry (topics, actions, tools, connected agents, knowledge sources) and publish them to approved channels such as Microsoft Teams.
Build the Power Platform components behind AI use cases: Power Automate flows, Dataverse data models and security roles, model-driven and canvas apps, AI Builder prompts, and Adaptive Card review experiences in Teams.
Integrate agents and flows with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data platform, Microsoft 365) using connectors, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool connections.
Move prototypes into production through environment strategy, solution packaging and application lifecycle management (ALM), publishing, and release validation. Assist with evaluating the cost of proposed solutions.
Write supporting code (Python, PowerShell, C#, or JSON) where low-code tooling falls short and use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and legacy code modernization.

AI Platform and Knowledge Engineering

Deploy and manage Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, and agents using Company-owned Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Cosmos DB so source data and vector indexes remain within the Company's tenant.
Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines (ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, vector and hybrid search) as reusable knowledge and context layers shared by multiple agents and automations.
Configure network isolation and identity for AI workloads, including private endpoints, private DNS, managed identities, and role-based access control (RBAC), and troubleshoot connectivity and authorization failures across platform boundaries.
Write system prompts and agent instructions, implements tool calling and orchestration, and run evaluations (test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, regression tests) before and after each release.

Security, Governance, and Responsible AI

Build every solution in accordance with Company security and data protection requirements, including least-privilege identities, scoped security roles, Entra ID app registrations, Power Platform data loss prevention (DLP) policies, sensitivity label requirements, and vendor and customer confidentiality obligations.
Verify each agent’s authentication model, including end-user, maker, and agent-author credentials, to ensure the agent returns only information the requesting user is authorized to access. Apply content-safety controls, input and output validation, and human review for consequential actions.
Support the AI intake and review process with technical assessments, help identify and remediate unsanctioned AI usage, and support Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, including permissions and oversharing remediation.

Operations, Support, and Enablement

Monitor delivered solutions for accuracy, performance, usage, security, cost, and continued fit with the business need; track licensing, token, credit, and capacity consumption and recommended actions to control spend.
Provide third-tier support and root-cause analysis for production AI and automation solutions, including occasional after-hours work for urgent issues or production automation failures.
Maintain documentation for each solution (business owner, purpose, architecture, data sources, access model, prompts, testing notes, support owner, change history, retirement criteria) and follow Company change, release, and lifecycle practices.
Deliver demos and technical training on approved AI tools, mentor citizen developers and IT colleagues on approved patterns and review their work for security and supportability before production.
Communicate the status, risks, dependencies, and expected business value of assigned use cases to the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI and business stakeholders.

Our Ideal Candidate

Strong understanding of generative AI, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, automation, low-code/no-code development, and practical business process improvement.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft’s AI tech stack including Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, AI Builder), Fabric, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
Working knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, managed identities, and role-based access control as they apply to AI workloads.
Proficiency in at least one language (Python, PowerShell, C#, or TypeScript), REST APIs, JSON, and Git.
Strong knowledge of data privacy, security, access controls, responsible AI practices, and change management.
Ability to diagnose problems across platform boundaries using logs, run histories, and vendor documentation, and to explain technical designs in plain language to leaders at all levels.
Must be well-organized, practical, collaborative, and pay close attention to detail.
Ability to drive and valid driver’s license required.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is required.
Three years of proven experience in application development, automation, data, or related information technology work, including one year of experience building and deploying production generative AI solutions such as agents, RAG solutions, or LLM-based automations.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry required.
Experience with Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and ERP or CRM integration (Dynamics 365 or similar) preferred.
Microsoft AI-102, PL-400, or AZ-204 certification preferred.

Physical Demands

(The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Regularly required to sit, see, speak and hear —frequent and regular use of hands and fingers to handle or feel. Recurring close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Constantly use hands and fingers to perform computer keyboard work. The ability to drive, and availability and capability to travel for business purposes.

Work Environment

(The work environment characteristics described here represent those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Perform most of the work in a relaxed environment but may be exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Encounter different temperatures while driving and getting in and out of a vehicle. Encounter different climates when traveling.

What We Can Offer You

Competitive pay to recognize your valuable contribution
401(k) with matching
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
Basic Life & AD&D, short-term disability, & and long-term disability
Wellness programs to focus on building healthy habits while earning prizes and cash bonuses throughout the year
Holiday, PTO, and Parental Leave, promoting work-life balance and personal growth
Casual dress attire
Family-owned company where you’re more than just another employee

Foley Industries – Foley Equipment, Foley Power Solutions, Foley Rental, and SITECH Central – proudly stands at the forefront of progress, serving customers in Kansas and Western Missouri for over nine decades. With a dedicated team of over 1,000 employees, we are committed to delivering exceptional service, top-quality parts and rentals, and unparalleled sales support across a comprehensive range of Caterpillar and allied construction equipment, power generation solutions, and cutting-edge SITECH construction technology. As we continue to empower our customers' success, we invite you to explore the endless opportunities that await you at Foley. To learn more about our company and join our team of industry leaders, please visit www.FoleyEq.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
Software Engineer II
Samsara's Mission
Improve the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of the operations that power the global economy.
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing, and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
The Safety Engineering - Triage & Insights Team owns and builds the systems and customer-facing products across web, mobile, and API surfaces that help fleets identify unsafe driving behaviors and recognize positive driving habits. We ingest sensor and media data, detect risky behaviors, and serve as the source of truth for safety events, from automations and the safety inbox to reports, safety scores, and driver coaching.
We are building the next generation of safety products to be AI-native. Our team is developing LLM-powered workflows, agentic systems, and conversational experiences that help customers move from manual incident review and reactive coaching toward proactive, intelligent, and self-serve safety operations. That includes AI-driven driver experiences that go beyond static reports into live, two-way interaction, and agent-assisted tools that let safety managers shape the way they triage and act on their data.
As a Software Engineer II on this team, you will own customer-facing features from concept to production. You will partner closely with Product, Design, and ML and AI engineering teams to evolve our products, refine workflows based on customer input, and deliver scalable, AI-powered solutions that make the world's operations safer, smarter, and more efficient.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world:
The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You want to build for scale:
With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
You are a life-long learner:
We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
You believe customers are more than a number:
Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user, and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
You are a team player:
Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

Own customer-facing features and platform capabilities end to end, from design and implementation through rollout and follow-through in production, including taking AI prototypes to production at scale.
Architect, build, test, and deliver full-stack products across reliable services, APIs, and web and mobile experiences, using technologies such as Golang, GraphQL, TypeScript, React, React Native, and MySQL. Previous experience with these technologies is not required.
Build AI-native product experiences: integrate LLMs into safety workflows, develop agent tooling and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and design the interactions between AI agents and the product UI.
Design and run evaluations and build human-in-the-loop feedback loops that continuously improve the accuracy, precision, and reliability of the insights we deliver.
Use AI coding tools and agents in your own workflow to plan, build, and ship faster, and help shape how our team develops software in an AI-assisted world.
Make thoughtful technical tradeoffs across speed, maintainability, scalability, cost, and customer impact.
Own the operational health of the production systems you build, improving reliability and scalability as our customer base grows.
Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Design, ML, and platform teams to deliver cohesive customer experiences.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

3+ years of professional software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating reliable customer-facing production systems.
Strong programming fundamentals in a language such as Golang, Java, or Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable code and reviewing peers' code for correctness and clarity.
Experience developing features or end-to-end solutions across backend services, APIs, and modern web applications.
Experience or demonstrated interest in AI-native development, including integrating LLMs into products, building agentic workflows, or running evaluations to improve the quality of AI-generated output.
Experience using data, metrics, logs, tests, or tracing to investigate issues, validate releases, and improve reliability.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
The Aspen Group (TAG) is one of the largest and most trusted retail healthcare business support organizations in the U.S., supporting over 23,000 healthcare professionals and team members at more than 1,150 locations across 48 states. Our five supported healthcare practices operate under the brands Aspen Dental, ClearChoice, WellNow, Chapter Aesthetic Studio, and Lovet. We’re committed to enabling healthcare professionals to focus on patient care while we handle the business operations that support them.

We are seeking an AI Platform Engineer.

Our Platform Engineering organization — spanning Delivery, Cloud, and SRE — is expanding to lead and maintain the company’s AI platform across the business. We’re hiring an AI Platform Engineer to own the foundation that lets every team use AI safely, reliably, and productively — built on Google Cloud and anchored by our two flagship enterprise AI platforms: Claude Enterprise and Google’s Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform).
In this hands-on role you’ll:

Operate and extend these platforms
Manage the end-to-end onboarding of users and teams onto them
Curate and govern the surrounding ecosystem of plugins, connectors, and marketplace extensions
Build the agents, tooling, and paved paths that turn AI from a novelty into everyday infrastructure.

You’ll do this on Google Cloud, increasingly through the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI). It’s a high-impact position with significant room to grow as our AI practice matures.

This is a strong fit for an engineer with a few years of Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or MLOps experience who is excited about AI enablement; someone who likes owning a platform end to end, from provisioning and onboarding through operations and governance.

Responsibilities

AI Platform Operations & LLMOps (on Google Cloud)

Deploy, scale, and operate Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, and related AI/LLM workloads in production (be it Google Cloud or Anthropic); keeping them reliable, performant, and cost-effective.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment automation for AI applications, agents, and models, increasingly on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI).
Instrumentation of AI systems with monitoring, logging, and observability (tracking latency, quality, usage, and spend) and responding to issues as part of an on-call rotation.
Manage integrations with model providers and APIs (Claude, Gemini, and code assistants), including authentication, rate limits, quotas, and failover.

Onboarding & User Lifecycle Management

Own the end-to-end onboarding experience for Claude Enterprise and Gemini Enterprise: provisioning, license/seat assignment, SSO, and group/role configuration.
Manage the full user lifecycle — onboarding, role changes, and deprovisioning — keeping access, entitlements, and seat assignments accurate and auditable.
Build automation and self-service flows so new users and teams get access to approved AI tools, with the right permissions, from day one.
Track adoption and seat utilization, and partner with IT and Security on identity, access reviews, and provisioning workflows.

Platform Extensions & Marketplace

Manage and curate platform extensions across our AI stack — Claude Enterprise plugins, connectors, and MCP integrations, plus Gemini Enterprise / Agent Platform extensions (Agent Garden, Model Garden, connectors).
Run the internal marketplace/catalog of approved extensions, agents, and integrations: review, vet, publish, version, and retire them.
Define how extensions are requested, evaluated, and governed — balancing easy self-service adoption against security and data-handling requirements.
Build and integrate custom plugins, connectors, and MCP servers that link our AI platforms to internal systems and data.

Internal AI Tooling & Paved Paths

Build internal tools, copilots, and agents — on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and Claude — that make it easy for teams to adopt AI in their workflows.
Develop reusable templates, reference architectures, and libraries for common patterns (RAG, summarization, agents, evaluations).
Integrate AI capabilities into existing internal systems and the developer toolchain.

Enablement & Training

Help engineers and other teams adopt approved AI tools through clear documentation, office hours, demos, and hands-on support — tightly linked to onboarding.
Create and maintain best-practice guides, prompt libraries, and onboarding materials.
Gather feedback from users to prioritize platform improvements and surface new opportunities.

Governance & Best Practices

Help define and implement standards, guardrails, and policies for safe, secure, and responsible AI use (data handling, access control, acceptable use) — including for plugins, extensions, and the marketplace.
Build evaluation harnesses and quality checks to measure AI output quality and catch regressions.
Partner with Security, IT, and leadership on compliance, access provisioning, and cost governance.

Requirements

3–5 years in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, MLOps, backend, or a similar software/infrastructure role.
Strong programming skills in Python, plus comfort with at least one other language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or Java a plus).
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud (GCP) as a primary cloud platform — AWS or Azure experience is welcome, but GCP is central to this role.
Working knowledge of how LLMs and AI APIs are used in applications (prompting, RAG, embeddings, tool/function calling, agents) — or strong fundamentals and clear eagerness to learn.
Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar).
Experience building and operating AI Delivery workstreams and production services.
Experience with identity, access, and provisioning — SSO/SAML/SCIM, role and group management, and user lifecycle (onboarding/deprovisioning).
Solid grasp of AI monitoring/observability and operational best practices.
Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain technical concepts to non-experts and write strong documentation — important for onboarding and enablement.
Based in (or willing to relocate to) the Chicago area and able to work onsite/hybrid.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Direct experience with Claude Enterprise — deployment, administration, onboarding, plugins, connectors, or MCP.
Experience with Gemini Enterprise and/or the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI) — Agent Builder/Agent Engine, Agent Garden, Model Garden, RAG/Vector Search.
Experience managing and creating platform extensions, a plugin ecosystem, or an internal app/agent marketplace.
Direct experience with LLMOps/MLOps tooling — model serving, vector databases, evaluation frameworks, agent orchestration (e.g., ADK, LangChain/LlamaIndex).
Experience deploying or integrating enterprise AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, NotebookLM) across an organization.
Experience building internal developer platforms or developer-experience tooling.
Familiarity with AI governance, security, or responsible-AI frameworks.
Experience running enablement, training, or developer-advocacy programs.
Familiarity with our stack: Google Cloud / BigQuery, Atlassian (Jira/Confluence), incident.io, Grafana/OTEL, Sentry, Microsoft 365.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

About the Team

You’ll join our Platform Engineering organization, which spans Delivery, Cloud, and SRE and reports to the Senior Director of Platform Engineering. We’re a pragmatic team focused on giving the rest of the company reliable, well-paved infrastructure to build on — and we’re now extending that mission to AI.

*This role is onsite 4 days/week in our Chicago office (Fulton Market District)
A generous benefits package that includes paid time off, health, dental, vision, and 401(k) savings plan with match

to design, build, and support a wide range of customer-facing and internal systems that power our two-sided marketplace. Step 3: Video interviews with team members
Step 4: Offer and reference check
Welcome aboard!

jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Backend)

Location:
Burlingame, CA  
Department:
ESS Engineering  
Reports to:
Senior Manager, Software Engineering  
Position Type:
Full-time  

About the Company

Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven sodium-ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid.  
Sodium-ion is cheap, readily available, and safe — making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market.  
Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt-level innovation at world-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, SunPower, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners including TDK Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and GM Ventures.  
We recently announced America's first sodium-ion grid storage factory in Sacramento with production starting Q1 2027, and over $1B in signed customer commitments including Jupiter Power and Energy Vault.  

About the Role

Peak Energy is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to help improve and scale the software platform that manages, ingests, processes, and surfaces operational data from our grid-scale battery storage systems.  
Our platform transforms raw telemetry from batteries deployed in the field into meaningful data and metrics that customers, operators, and engineers rely on every day. As Peak grows from pilot deployments to gigawatt-scale production, this software becomes increasingly critical to our operations.  
This is a hands-on backend software engineering role focused on application development, API design, data processing, and system integration. You'll build and improve the services that connect our battery systems, manufacturing operations, and cloud applications, ensuring data is processed reliably and accessible across the organization.  
You'll join a small software team with significant ownership over the systems you build, working closely with ESS Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Product.  

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and services that manage, ingest, process, and surface operational data from deployed battery systems.  

Build and maintain APIs and application interfaces that enable communication between battery systems, cloud services, and internal applications.  

Develop data processing pipelines that support critical battery performance metrics, including round-trip efficiency, availability, and cycle tracking.  

Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data models to support operational applications, reporting, and analytics.  

Develop software integrations connecting manufacturing systems, physical devices, and cloud applications.  

Improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of backend services as Peak's deployment footprint grows.  

Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and systems engineering teams to integrate new functionality and support evolving product requirements.  

Troubleshoot production issues, improve application observability, and continuously enhance software quality.  

What You'll Bring (Minimum Qualifications)

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend application development.  

Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade backend applications and services.  

Experience designing, developing, and maintaining REST APIs or other service interfaces.  

Strong SQL skills, including PostgreSQL, database schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.  

Experience developing data processing pipelines or applications that ingest and transform data from multiple sources.  

Familiarity with cloud-based application development on Azure, AWS, or GCP.  

Strong understanding of software architecture, testing, debugging, and version control.  

Experience owning production software, including troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous improvement.  

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, or similar cloud application services.  

Experience with asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, or distributed systems.  

Familiarity with real-time data streaming technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or Kinesis.  

Experience with battery systems, energy storage, IoT, industrial telemetry, or hardware-integrated software.  

Experience working with time-series data and high-volume telemetry.  

Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD workflows, and modern software deployment practices.  

Experience partnering with embedded software, firmware, or hardware engineering teams.  

Prior experience in a fast-paced startup environment building new software systems.  

Our Core Values

Speed Through Focus

— Move fast but understand why. Focus on the goal, don't sacrifice quality.  

Mission Over Self

— Put the company's mission and team success ahead of individual interests.  

Face the Brutal Truth

— Transparency, honesty, big-picture curiosity. Fearless decision making.  

Be a Good Person

— Kindness, collaboration, and teamwork.  

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this role is $180,000 - $240,000
, with actual pay varying based on work location, experience, and skills. Our competitive benefits package includes:  
Flexible time off  

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage  

Strong 401(k) plan  

Equity opportunities  

Many great work perks  

Join us to thrive in a supportive environment while making a meaningful impact in the energy sector!  
At Peak Energy Technologies Inc., we believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace makes us a more capable, innovative, and competitive company. We welcome people who represent diversity in their backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. Peak Energy Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, aiming to reach our company's full potential by cultivating an inclusive workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Job Title: Software Engineer

Job Overview

We are seeking a Python Senior Software Engineers to build and maintain intelligent automation solutions focused on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) in the healthcare industry. We are seeking eight engineers in total. This role requires strong Python skills, particularly in Selenium and OpenCV, and a deep understanding of healthcare billing workflows. Experience with AI/ML, OCR, and cloud platforms (especially Azure) is highly desirable.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain robust automation scripts for RCM processes using Python, Selenium, and OpenCV.
Automate web-based tasks (e.g., web scraping, form submissions, browser interactions) using Selenium.
Utilize OpenCV for image recognition and data extraction in visual and document-based workflows.
Apply AI and machine learning techniques (e.g., OCR, NLP, predictive analytics) to enhance automation and improve process outcomes.
Integrate automation solutions with billing software, EHR systems, and healthcare web portals.
Ensure all automation adheres to healthcare data privacy and security regulations (e.g., HIPAA).
Create and maintain clear, comprehensive technical documentation for all automation workflows.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations for accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.
Build resilient automation workflows that integrate with legacy systems and modern web platforms.
Work alongside SMEs and operations teams to translate manual workflows into digital automation.
Maintain secure credential handling, logging, and audit trails in line with HITRUST/HIPAA compliance.
Leverage Azure services (e.g., Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Key Vault) to support scalable automation.

Requirements

Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Experience with Selenium for browser-based automation.
Experience applying AI/ML tools such as OCR, NLP, or predictive modeling to automation use cases.
Understanding healthcare RCM workflows (e.g., billing, coding, claims, denial management).
Knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare security best practices.
Strong analytical, debugging, and documentation skills.

services, and business intelligence applications. About Bioyond Robotics Bioyond Robotics is advancing laboratory automation through intelligent robotics, liquid handling, integrated workstations, scheduling software, and AI-enabled systems. Our platforms are designed to help scientific research, biopharmaceutical, clinical, and analytical laboratories improve throughput, reproducibility, consistency, and unattended operation. Bioyond solutions support applications including NGS, methylation analysis, proteomics, metabolomics, nucleic acid and protein extraction and purification, qPCR, ELISA, drug screening, cell culture, and other complex laboratory workflows.
About the Role Bioyond Robotics is seeking a scientifically trained Field Applications & Automation Engineer to support the growth of our U.S. business.
This individual will serve as the primary scientific and technical partner to customers throughout the pre-sales and post-sales lifecycle. The role will work closely with scientists, automation groups, process-development teams, manufacturing and production organizations, analytical-development groups, QC laboratories, and commercial teams to understand complex workflows and translate them into practical automation solutions.
The successful candidate will combine a strong life-science background with hands-on laboratory automation experience. They must be comfortable moving between scientific workflow discussions, technical solution design, customer demonstrations, method development, integrated-system implementation, and post-installation application support.
What You Will Do Lead scientific and technical discovery meetings with customers in research, multi-omics, process development, manufacturing, MSAT, analytical development, QC, and laboratory automation organizations.
Document current-state and future-state workflows, including sample types, liquid volumes, plate and consumable formats, throughput requirements, process timing, dependencies, critical quality requirements, data flows, and operator interactions.
Translate customer workflows into user requirements, automation concepts, system configurations, technical proposals, statements of work, and acceptance criteria.
Design integrated solutions using Bioyond liquid-handling robots, material-handling robots, plate storage, scheduling and control software, and third-party laboratory instruments.
Evaluate and support multi-omics workflows such as nucleic acid extraction, normalization, PCR and qPCR setup, NGS library preparation, methylation workflows, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, mass-spectrometry sample preparation, and related high-throughput sample-preparation processes.
Support biologics development and manufacturing workflows used by production, process development, MSAT, analytical development, and QC groups. Relevant workflows may include cell-line development, clone screening, media and feed preparation, upstream process-development sampling, downstream purification sample preparation, buffer preparation, protein purification, ELISA, titer analysis, protein concentration, chromatography sample preparation, and other at-line or offline analytical workflows.
Develop, configure, test, and optimize automated methods, including deck layouts, liquid classes, pipetting parameters, scheduling logic, robotic movements, device integrations, error-recovery routines, and unattended operation.
Support pre-sales activities including technical presentations, workflow consultations, instrument demonstrations, feasibility studies, proofs of concept, RFP responses, site assessments, technical proposal development, and customer-facing ROI discussions.
Partner with sales to establish technical credibility, identify customer risks and requirements, and ensure proposed solutions are both scientifically appropriate and operationally achievable.
Support Factory Acceptance Testing and Site Acceptance Testing, application commissioning, method transfer, customer training, workflow validation, and post-installation optimization.
Troubleshoot application, software, consumable, liquid-handling, scheduling, and workflow-related issues, collaborating with the Field Service Engineer and Bioyond's global engineering and applications teams when necessary.
Create and maintain protocols, application documentation, SOPs, training materials, workflow diagrams, technical reports, application notes, and reusable solution templates.
Capture customer feedback and field requirements and communicate them to product management, engineering, software, and applications-development teams.
Represent Bioyond at customer workshops, conferences, industry events, demonstrations, and technical seminars.

Required Qualifications Bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, bioengineering, chemical engineering, biological engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
At least four years of relevant experience in laboratory automation, field applications, assay development, process development, scientific instrumentation, or an equivalent customer-facing technical role.
Hands-on experience with automated liquid handlers, laboratory robotics, integrated workcells, or high-throughput scientific instrumentation.
Demonstrated scientific depth in at least one of the following areas, with practical working knowledge of the other: multi-omics and molecular workflows, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, NGS, PCR/qPCR, or sample preparation; or biologics development and manufacturing workflows, including upstream process development, downstream processing, analytical development, QC, production, or MSAT.
Ability to understand a manual scientific protocol and convert it into an automated, scalable, reproducible workflow.
Experience developing or optimizing automated methods, protocols, scripts, or instrument programs.
Strong troubleshooting skills across scientific methods, liquid handling, consumables, hardware, software, scheduling, and integrated workflows.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, training, and relationship-management skills.
Ability to work independently in a field-based environment while collaborating effectively across global commercial, engineering, applications, service, and product teams.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40%-60%, sometimes on short notice.

Preferred Qualifications Experience with platforms from Hamilton, Tecan, Beckman Coulter, Agilent, HighRes Biosolutions, Biosero, Opentrons, Thermo Fisher Scientific, or comparable laboratory-automation providers.
Experience integrating centrifuges, incubators, plate readers, washers, sealers, peelers, thermocyclers, analytical instruments, barcode readers, robotic arms, and other third-party devices.
Familiarity with Python, C#, Visual Basic, SQL, APIs, device drivers, or laboratory scheduling and orchestration software.
Experience with LIMS, ELN, laboratory informatics, data integrity, and instrument-to-software integrations.
Familiarity with GxP environments, design controls, change control, 21 CFR Part 11, computer-system validation, IQ/OQ/PQ, FAT/SAT, and regulated laboratory documentation.

new_jobs.description:
Back to jobs

New

Software Engineer, Agent Delivery

New York

About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

$135,000 - $180,000

Full-time / Onsite (5 days/week)

About The Role

We’re hiring a Software Engineer, Agent Delivery to deploy production AI agents inside some of the world’s largest supply chain companies.

You’ll work directly with customer operators, engineers, and executives to understand how critical workflows actually run. Then you’ll design integrations, debug production systems, and ship AI-powered workflows into environments that are often undocumented, fragmented, and business-critical.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer operations. You’ll own deployments from initial discovery through production launch, spending time with customers both remotely and onsite, solving complex operational problems and turning those solutions into reusable product capabilities.

Success in this role is measured by outcomes: can you get systems live, make them reliable, and solve problems in environments you don’t fully control? Every deployment teaches us something new about how supply chain companies operate. The patterns you uncover become product features, and what you solve for one customer often becomes a capability we ship across the platform.

The impact you will have

Lead high-impact customer deployments from problem definition through production, designing, prototyping, building, and deploying AI agents and workflows that change how work gets done and run reliably at scale.
Embed in customer workflows and build relationships from ICs and operators up to executives, turning messy business requirements into clear technical solutions that solve the underlying problem, not just the first request.
Make design decisions across agent behavior, application logic, data, evals, security, and reliability, and set the patterns for how Pallet agents are deployed in production.
Connect Pallet agents to the systems, APIs, and data customers already rely on, working directly with their engineering and ops teams to get around technical constraints.
Stay accountable after launch by debugging failures, evaluating and improving agent quality, and working with Engineering and Product to clear anything blocking a successful deployment.
Turn what you learn in the field into reusable agents, integrations, evals, and frameworks, and bring recurring needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering to shape the core platform.

Who You Are

1+ years of experience building and owning production systems in high-growth startups or similarly demanding environments.
Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and event-driven architectures.
Proven ability to debug complex systems in production.
Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where documentation is incomplete, and requirements evolve quickly.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working directly with customers is a strong plus

Our Tech Stack

Backend: Node + TypeScript on Encore.dev. Event-driven design with message passing and queues. Hosted on GCP
Database: PostgreSQL
LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google for foundation models; fine-tuned models on Vertex AI
Browser Automation: Playwright
Frontend: Next.js + React + TypeScript. Hosted on Vercel
Observability: Datadog for logging and metrics

Location:
New York, Flatiron, 5 days a week

The estimated salary range for this role is $135,000–$180,000, depending on experience and skill set. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and growth opportunities. Final compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors, including experience, qualifications, and location.

Our Benefits

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits
🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation
➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance
❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage
💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff
🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future
🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families
📚 Yearly learning and development stipend
🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area and New York employees
🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office

🍔 Daily catered lunches and dinners provided in office
💪 Complimentary On-Site Gym: Our SF office has a fully equipped gym
✈️ Onboarding trip to one of our offices if you work remotely
🥤 Monthly happy hours
🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip.

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. new_jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
The AI & Automation Engineer
is a hands-on technical role responsible for designing, building, deploying, and supporting AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, and automation solutions on Company-approved AI platforms. The position transforms prioritized use cases into secure, supportable production solutions, develops reusable patterns and knowledge layers, and serves as the primary technical builder for the Company's AI and automation programs under the direction of the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI.

This position will require regular (every week) in-person attendance at one of our Foley Equipment offices with a partial week work-from-home opportunity. At this time, fully-remote is not available. Kansas City or Park City preferred.

What You Will Do

Solution Design and Development

Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Foundry (topics, actions, tools, connected agents, knowledge sources) and publish them to approved channels such as Microsoft Teams.
Build the Power Platform components behind AI use cases: Power Automate flows, Dataverse data models and security roles, model-driven and canvas apps, AI Builder prompts, and Adaptive Card review experiences in Teams.
Integrate agents and flows with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data platform, Microsoft 365) using connectors, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool connections.
Move prototypes into production through environment strategy, solution packaging and application lifecycle management (ALM), publishing, and release validation. Assist with evaluating the cost of proposed solutions.
Write supporting code (Python, PowerShell, C#, or JSON) where low-code tooling falls short and use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and legacy code modernization.

AI Platform and Knowledge Engineering

Deploy and manage Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, and agents using Company-owned Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Cosmos DB so source data and vector indexes remain within the Company's tenant.
Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines (ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, vector and hybrid search) as reusable knowledge and context layers shared by multiple agents and automations.
Configure network isolation and identity for AI workloads, including private endpoints, private DNS, managed identities, and role-based access control (RBAC), and troubleshoot connectivity and authorization failures across platform boundaries.
Write system prompts and agent instructions, implements tool calling and orchestration, and run evaluations (test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, regression tests) before and after each release.

Security, Governance, and Responsible AI

Build every solution in accordance with Company security and data protection requirements, including least-privilege identities, scoped security roles, Entra ID app registrations, Power Platform data loss prevention (DLP) policies, sensitivity label requirements, and vendor and customer confidentiality obligations.
Verify each agent’s authentication model, including end-user, maker, and agent-author credentials, to ensure the agent returns only information the requesting user is authorized to access. Apply content-safety controls, input and output validation, and human review for consequential actions.
Support the AI intake and review process with technical assessments, help identify and remediate unsanctioned AI usage, and support Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, including permissions and oversharing remediation.

Operations, Support, and Enablement

Monitor delivered solutions for accuracy, performance, usage, security, cost, and continued fit with the business need; track licensing, token, credit, and capacity consumption and recommended actions to control spend.
Provide third-tier support and root-cause analysis for production AI and automation solutions, including occasional after-hours work for urgent issues or production automation failures.
Maintain documentation for each solution (business owner, purpose, architecture, data sources, access model, prompts, testing notes, support owner, change history, retirement criteria) and follow Company change, release, and lifecycle practices.
Deliver demos and technical training on approved AI tools, mentor citizen developers and IT colleagues on approved patterns and review their work for security and supportability before production.
Communicate the status, risks, dependencies, and expected business value of assigned use cases to the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI and business stakeholders.

Our Ideal Candidate

Strong understanding of generative AI, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, automation, low-code/no-code development, and practical business process improvement.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft’s AI tech stack including Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, AI Builder), Fabric, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
Working knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, managed identities, and role-based access control as they apply to AI workloads.
Proficiency in at least one language (Python, PowerShell, C#, or TypeScript), REST APIs, JSON, and Git.
Strong knowledge of data privacy, security, access controls, responsible AI practices, and change management.
Ability to diagnose problems across platform boundaries using logs, run histories, and vendor documentation, and to explain technical designs in plain language to leaders at all levels.
Must be well-organized, practical, collaborative, and pay close attention to detail.
Ability to drive and valid driver’s license required.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is required.
Three years of proven experience in application development, automation, data, or related information technology work, including one year of experience building and deploying production generative AI solutions such as agents, RAG solutions, or LLM-based automations.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry required.
Experience with Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and ERP or CRM integration (Dynamics 365 or similar) preferred.
Microsoft AI-102, PL-400, or AZ-204 certification preferred.

Physical Demands

(The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Regularly required to sit, see, speak and hear —frequent and regular use of hands and fingers to handle or feel. Recurring close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Constantly use hands and fingers to perform computer keyboard work. The ability to drive, and availability and capability to travel for business purposes.

Work Environment

(The work environment characteristics described here represent those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Perform most of the work in a relaxed environment but may be exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Encounter different temperatures while driving and getting in and out of a vehicle. Encounter different climates when traveling.

What We Can Offer You

Competitive pay to recognize your valuable contribution
401(k) with matching
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
Basic Life & AD&D, short-term disability, & and long-term disability
Wellness programs to focus on building healthy habits while earning prizes and cash bonuses throughout the year
Holiday, PTO, and Parental Leave, promoting work-life balance and personal growth
Casual dress attire
Family-owned company where you’re more than just another employee

Foley Industries – Foley Equipment, Foley Power Solutions, Foley Rental, and SITECH Central – proudly stands at the forefront of progress, serving customers in Kansas and Western Missouri for over nine decades. With a dedicated team of over 1,000 employees, we are committed to delivering exceptional service, top-quality parts and rentals, and unparalleled sales support across a comprehensive range of Caterpillar and allied construction equipment, power generation solutions, and cutting-edge SITECH construction technology. As we continue to empower our customers' success, we invite you to explore the endless opportunities that await you at Foley. Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
Software Engineer II
Samsara's Mission
Improve the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of the operations that power the global economy.
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing, and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
The Safety Engineering - Triage & Insights Team owns and builds the systems and customer-facing products across web, mobile, and API surfaces that help fleets identify unsafe driving behaviors and recognize positive driving habits. We ingest sensor and media data, detect risky behaviors, and serve as the source of truth for safety events, from automations and the safety inbox to reports, safety scores, and driver coaching.
We are building the next generation of safety products to be AI-native. Our team is developing LLM-powered workflows, agentic systems, and conversational experiences that help customers move from manual incident review and reactive coaching toward proactive, intelligent, and self-serve safety operations. That includes AI-driven driver experiences that go beyond static reports into live, two-way interaction, and agent-assisted tools that let safety managers shape the way they triage and act on their data.
As a Software Engineer II on this team, you will own customer-facing features from concept to production. You will partner closely with Product, Design, and ML and AI engineering teams to evolve our products, refine workflows based on customer input, and deliver scalable, AI-powered solutions that make the world's operations safer, smarter, and more efficient.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world:
The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You want to build for scale:
With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
You are a life-long learner:
We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
You believe customers are more than a number:
Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user, and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
You are a team player:
Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

Own customer-facing features and platform capabilities end to end, from design and implementation through rollout and follow-through in production, including taking AI prototypes to production at scale.
Architect, build, test, and deliver full-stack products across reliable services, APIs, and web and mobile experiences, using technologies such as Golang, GraphQL, TypeScript, React, React Native, and MySQL. Previous experience with these technologies is not required.
Build AI-native product experiences: integrate LLMs into safety workflows, develop agent tooling and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and design the interactions between AI agents and the product UI.
Design and run evaluations and build human-in-the-loop feedback loops that continuously improve the accuracy, precision, and reliability of the insights we deliver.
Use AI coding tools and agents in your own workflow to plan, build, and ship faster, and help shape how our team develops software in an AI-assisted world.
Make thoughtful technical tradeoffs across speed, maintainability, scalability, cost, and customer impact.
Own the operational health of the production systems you build, improving reliability and scalability as our customer base grows.
Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Design, ML, and platform teams to deliver cohesive customer experiences.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

3+ years of professional software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating reliable customer-facing production systems.
Strong programming fundamentals in a language such as Golang, Java, or Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable code and reviewing peers' code for correctness and clarity.
Experience developing features or end-to-end solutions across backend services, APIs, and modern web applications.
Experience or demonstrated interest in AI-native development, including integrating LLMs into products, building agentic workflows, or running evaluations to improve the quality of AI-generated output.
Experience using data, metrics, logs, tests, or tracing to investigate issues, validate releases, and improve reliability.
Ability to independently own moderately complex projects, with the ability to estimate, communicate, and deliver on milestones.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering and cross-functional partners.
A growth mindset, strong product intuition, and excitement for learning new technologies and building impactful customer experiences.

An ideal candidate also has:

Experience building and scaling customer-facing AI or LLM-powered products in production, including agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering, or conversational and voice experiences.
Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as Langfuse or Eino, and optimizing LLM-powered systems for cost and token efficiency.
A track record of using AI coding agents to plan and deliver features, not just autocomplete.
Experience working across the stack with modern technologies such as Go, GraphQL, TypeScript, React, React Native, and AWS (or Azure or Google Cloud).
Familiarity with observability, rollout practices, and monitoring approaches that improve product reliability and operational excellence.
Experience operating in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments with distributed teams.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

ProSomnus Sleep Technologies is seeking a versatile Software Engineer to develop and maintain software for connected medical devices and supporting applications.

This hands-on role spans mobile applications, embedded sensor technology, and cloud-based services. The engineer will contribute to product features, software enhancements, and reliability improvements while helping advance automated testing, build infrastructure, and release processes.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, working across technologies, and improving how software is developed, tested, and delivered within a small, collaborative engineering team.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Software & Product Development

Design, develop, test, and maintain software features for connected medical devices and associated applications.
Contribute to iOS and Android mobile applications, including BLE connectivity, data synchronization, and user-facing functionality.
Support embedded sensor firmware, device integration, backend services, and web applications as project needs require.
Investigate and resolve software defects, performance issues, and field-reported problems.
Improve existing software through refactoring, dependency updates, and reliability enhancements.
Participate in the development of new product capabilities and future device technologies.

Test Automation & Software Quality

Develop automated testing tools and frameworks for mobile applications, embedded devices, APIs, and backend services.
Contribute to sensor and firmware test automation, including BLE protocol verification, data acquisition, and regression testing.
Develop and maintain unit, integration, and automated regression tests using tools such as Flutter Test, pytest, Appium, or similar frameworks.

The Aspen Group (TAG) is one of the largest and most trusted retail healthcare business support organizations in the U.S., supporting over 23,000 healthcare professionals and team members at more than 1,150 locations across 48 states. Our five supported healthcare practices operate under the brands Aspen Dental, ClearChoice, WellNow, Chapter Aesthetic Studio, and Lovet. We are seeking an AI Platform Engineer.

Our Platform Engineering organization — spanning Delivery, Cloud, and SRE — is expanding to lead and maintain the company’s AI platform across the business. We’re hiring an AI Platform Engineer to own the foundation that lets every team use AI safely, reliably, and productively — built on Google Cloud and anchored by our two flagship enterprise AI platforms: Claude Enterprise and Google’s Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform).
In this hands-on role you’ll:

Operate and extend these platforms
Manage the end-to-end onboarding of users and teams onto them
Curate and govern the surrounding ecosystem of plugins, connectors, and marketplace extensions
Build the agents, tooling, and paved paths that turn AI from a novelty into everyday infrastructure.

You’ll do this on Google Cloud, increasingly through the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI). It’s a high-impact position with significant room to grow as our AI practice matures.

This is a strong fit for an engineer with a few years of Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or MLOps experience who is excited about AI enablement; someone who likes owning a platform end to end, from provisioning and onboarding through operations and governance.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment automation for AI applications, agents, and models, increasingly on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI).
Instrumentation of AI systems with monitoring, logging, and observability (tracking latency, quality, usage, and spend) and responding to issues as part of an on-call rotation.
Manage integrations with model providers and APIs (Claude, Gemini, and code assistants), including authentication, rate limits, quotas, and failover.

Onboarding & User Lifecycle Management

Own the end-to-end onboarding experience for Claude Enterprise and Gemini Enterprise: provisioning, license/seat assignment, SSO, and group/role configuration.
Manage the full user lifecycle — onboarding, role changes, and deprovisioning — keeping access, entitlements, and seat assignments accurate and auditable.
Build automation and self-service flows so new users and teams get access to approved AI tools, with the right permissions, from day one.
Track adoption and seat utilization, and partner with IT and Security on identity, access reviews, and provisioning workflows.

Platform Extensions & Marketplace

Manage and curate platform extensions across our AI stack — Claude Enterprise plugins, connectors, and MCP integrations, plus Gemini Enterprise / Agent Platform extensions (Agent Garden, Model Garden, connectors).
Run the internal marketplace/catalog of approved extensions, agents, and integrations: review, vet, publish, version, and retire them.
Define how extensions are requested, evaluated, and governed — balancing easy self-service adoption against security and data-handling requirements.
Build and integrate custom plugins, connectors, and MCP servers that link our AI platforms to internal systems and data.

Integrate AI capabilities into existing internal systems and the developer toolchain.
